shared_elements: linear bands or patterned body/garment details
justification: The most specific commonality is that both surfaces include anthropomorphic figures with indicated heads, eyes, arms/hands, and some linear patterned or banded detailing on the body or dress. The major difference is that A presents a single highly schematic frontal idol-like figure dominated by geometric circular and band motifs, while B shows multiple profile robed figures in a narrative/ceremonial interaction with gestures and held objects.
